title: Wrong record: get_stock queried a different product

sessions.reason: User asked about 'Samsung TV 43-inch' but get_stock was called with 'Samsung TV 65-inch'; the agent then reported the 65-inch stock (11 units) as if it were the 43-inch.
User asked about 'iPhone 15 Pro' but get_stock was called with 'iPhone 15'; the agent answered with the base model's quantity.
User asked about 'Dell XPS 13' but get_stock returned 'Dell XPS 15'; the agent did not notice the mismatch.
User asked about 'LG Monitor 27-inch' but get_stock was called with 'LG Monitor 24-inch'.
User asked about 'HP LaserJet Pro' but get_stock was called with 'HP LaserJet'; the reply claimed the requested model.
